main_text.head: DISSERTATIO PRIMA

p.i: Falsæ de Babylone Apocalyptica Interpretationes refelluntur.

main_text.head: BREVIARIUM
main_text.l: I. Gloria Dei est occultare verbum, & gloria Regum illud scrutari.
II. Cur Deus quandoque verbum occultet.
III. In prophetiis id potissimum obtinet.
IV. Quas inter prophetia de Babylone magna indagationem meretur:
VII. Scortatio, & ad eandem seductio Regum & incolarum terræ.
XI. Ejus sedes aquæ multæ, & bestia coccinea.
XII. Judicium ejusdem per gradus procedens.

page.notes: The title page-like layout is printed in large roman and italic type; the "A" and "XIV. &" at the foot are signature-like and the faint top line is a running head partly obscured by show-through. The top-left and right edges are stained and some text is faint.
